title: HoneyCup Cafe
description: A Simple SMP with a few QoL Plugins and a player ran future.
body:
☕🍯 HoneyCup Cafe SMP | Cozy Survival • Community-Driven • Just Launched 🍯☕

HoneyCup Cafe SMP is a relaxed, cozy Minecraft Survival SMP focused on community, creativity, and long-term worlds. We keep things simple and welcoming, with quality-of-life features that don’t take away from the vanilla experience.

✨ What to expect:

Vanilla-style survival with light QoL tweaks

VeinMiner for faster, less grindy mining

Server-run GUI shop for easy buying & selling

Friendly and Responsive Owner

Villager Buckets

Grief protection & fair rules

Long-term map (no constant resets)

Whether you want to build a café, run a shop, or just chill and mine at your own pace, HoneyCup Cafe SMP is a place to relax and enjoy Minecraft without pressure or pay-to-win mechanics.
